newsitem.title: USA: Bull Run acquires warrants for Gray shrs.
newsitem.headline: Bull Run acquires warrants for Gray shrs.

text.p: Bull Run Corp said Thursday it acquired, for $5 million, 500 shares of Gray Communications Systems Inc Series B preferred stock and warrants to purchase 250,000 shares of Gray's Class A Common Stock at $24 per share, and exchanged a $10 million 8 percent subordinated note for 1,000 shares of Gray's Series A preferred stock.

The 8 percent subordinated note was originally purchased from Gray in January 1996, along with warrants to purchase 487,500 shares of Gray's Class A common stock at $17.88 per share, for $10 million, a statement from Bull Run said.
Of the total warrants owned by Bull Run to purchase 737,500 shares of Gray's Class A common stock, 600,000 are fully vested, with the remaining warrants vesting periodically over five years.
